proves.claim: add --from-record <hash> files an item whose title, rows, bar and check come from the accepted snapshot of that hash, and an unknown hash is refused with a named fix.

cli.commands-add.from-record.why: An item must file from the stored hashed snapshot, and outside text must reach a builder only as quoted data.

proves.claim: The snapshot text enters the item brief inside a quoted block, never as an instruction.

cli.commands-add.from-record-quoted.why: An item must file from the stored hashed snapshot, and outside text must reach a builder only as quoted data.
